title: Training for my first half marathon
body: Four weeks in and running three times a week. Any tips for building distance without getting injured?

replies.text: Increase your long run by about 10% each week and keep one rest day between runs.

title: How do you stay consistent?
body: I keep missing workouts in the second week. What helps you keep a routine?

title: Best high protein breakfast ideas
body: Looking for quick breakfasts with at least 25 g of protein. Share what works for you.

replies.text: Eggs with oats and a glass of milk is my go to. Easy and filling.

title: Down 4 kg in 8 weeks
body: Tracking my meals and weighing in every Sunday made the difference. Small steps really add up.

replies.text: Amazing work! Weekly weigh-ins are the best habit.

title: How many rest days do you take?
body: I train five days a week but feel tired by Thursday. Is two rest days better?
